options: God sent his Son, Jesus, to save us. Jesus is God and man. He lived with Mary and Joseph in Nazareth.

1-1-1.why: This is a common misunderstanding. God made each of us to know him, love him and be happy with him forever. He gave us a heart to love.

1-1-2.q: Which statement is TRUE? (Lesson: God takes care of us)
options: God our Father takes care of everything he made. He knows each of us by name and gives us what we need.

1-1-2.why: CCC 301: “With creation, God does not abandon his creatures to themselves.”
